greeting.text: Fact: the passages connect and quantities are conserved. Inference: one shortest path is the only useful path. The chorus disputes that inference. Read all three conductors, match their demand, then repeat Two → One → Three. Components are marked in your journal after acceptance.

hint:{{missionId}}.text: Meet the three conductors in this labyrinth. First inspect, then match demand 1, 2, 3 and pulse Two → One → Three. Return to the keeper; the linked road shrine will retain the new current. Reactivate the maze generator.
